verdict.rationale: Bruno lets users write documentation alongside collections and publish it as shareable HTML (bruno-docs-20), and its core client functionality lets users browse/run request collections directly, with AI able to auto-generate docs and tests for review (bruno-docs-53, bruno-docs-41). However there is no evidence of a Swagger/OpenAPI-style interactive reference with embedded 'try-it' runnable examples — a probe for OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints on the docs site returned 404s (bruno-probe-2), and no evidence describes the published HTML docs as interactive/runnable rather than static.  missing for 10: confirmed interactivity/runnability of the published HTML docs, OpenAPI/Swagger-style live reference, independent user reports of exploring runnable examples.
